chapters.title: Ready for delivery
chapters.description: Door closed. Bolt position confirms the box is secured.

chapters.title: One-use courier access
chapters.description: The role-bound code retracts the bolt before the door opens.

chapters.title: A parcel arrives
chapters.description: The distance array confirms presence across three stable samples.

chapters.title: Delivery secured
chapters.description: Door feedback and bolt feedback must both reach their targets.

chapters.title: A used code is rejected
chapters.description: The courier token has already been redeemed.

chapters.title: Owner retrieval
chapters.description: An owner code authorizes collection of the parcel.

chapters.title: Retrieval detected
chapters.description: The parcel leaves the sensor array during approved access.

chapters.title: Ready for the next delivery
chapters.description: The door closes and the measured bolt position confirms locking.
